operation.description: cluster recipes are named <type>-cluster and are used by labs/<lab>/clusters/<id>/cluster.yaml.

root.description: The OpenTofu root module, relative to this file.

modules.description: Other OpenTofu modules the root uses, relative to this file. A change to them plans the recipe's guests again, as a change to the root does.

inputs.description: JSON Schema validating the guest's hardware, network, and provision.inputs, relative to this file.

guestType.description: The guest type this recipe provisions; vm when left out.

secrets.description: The provision.secrets a guest must set for this recipe.

guestFilesystem.description: Explicitly authorizes native online root growth and capacity verification through the Proxmox guest agent, including reconciliation after an infrastructure no-op. Only the supported NixOS ext4 layout is accepted.

image.description: Overrides the server's default OpenTofu image.
